title: The New Soviet Man
logline: Moscow, 1937: Stalin orders a scientist to build the perfect citizen out of the dead. It works.
plot: Moscow, 1937. During Stalin's Great Terror, a brilliant doctor is ordered by the Party to create the New Soviet Man in a secret laboratory. Stitching together the bodies of executed prisoners, he brings a creature to life with electricity: a monster with a gentle mind, horrified by its own face. Watched by a KGB officer who informs on everyone, the doctor teaches the creature to read Lenin and Tolstoy, but when the Politburo plans to use it as a weapon and the doctor's family is denounced, the creature escapes into the snowbound city to take revenge on the state that made it.

title: The Valley Below
logline: Egypt, 1922: an expedition breaks into a sealed chamber and wakes the giant creatures the pharaohs buried.
plot: In 1922 an adventurous archaeologist and his rival lead an expedition into the desert to find a lost tomb. Beneath it they discover a vast cavern where giant mutated creatures, ancient monsters that the pharaohs sealed underground, have survived for five thousand years. When the expedition's dynamite wakes them, the monsters rampage out of the desert toward Cairo, devouring everything in their path. With the army helpless, the archaeologist must use the clues in the tomb's carvings to find the only way to drive the beasts back underground.

title: Legion
logline: Judea, AD 30: a Roman centurion is possessed by a demon, and only a carpenter's followers believe they can cast it out.
plot: Rome, AD 64. Under the emperor Nero, Christians are crucified and thrown to the lions in the arena, and a hardened Roman general returns from the eastern provinces possessed by a demon. Gladiators die in the night, the emperor's palace is haunted by voices, and the general speaks in the tongues of the dead. When the pagan priests' rituals fail, a Christian slave girl condemned to the Colosseum is the only one who knows how to cast the demon out. Caught between the emperor's cruelty and the evil spirit, she must perform an exorcism before the possessed general turns the legions on Rome itself.
